## Privacy and scope review

- [ ] Only synthetic data; no learner records, worksheets, handwriting, photographs or production exports.
- [ ] No credentials or private data in bundles, logs, screenshots or artifacts.
- [ ] Nothing in this diff, description or comments identifies a real learner, family, school, account or infrastructure project (all contributions must be suitable for public publication).
- [ ] Changes follow the technical decisions; feature scope is not treated as an MVP commitment.
- [ ] Any architecture or scope change is documented separately.
- [ ] No paid infrastructure or automatic production deployment added.
